name: THINH HOANG
typed: building AI agents that run in production
orchestrating an AI dev team with Claude Code
intro: I build AI agents that do real work: they hold conversations, call tools, read images, remember context and hand off to a human when they should. Then I test them the way a real user would. Most of that code is private; every number on this page comes from real data and is drawn by code in this repo.

projects.title: Production AI Agents
projects.desc: Agents that hold real conversations end to end: reasoning, tools, vision, memory, human handoff and metrics, shipped to production. The code is private; the skyline above is the trail it left.

projects.title: Video Studio
projects.desc: Animated storytime videos made entirely in code: script → Gemini TTS → lip-sync → JSON storyboard → 1080p MP4. No editor, no timeline; an agent can write one.

projects.title: HR CV Matcher
projects.desc: Recruitment SaaS: bulk CV upload, AI extraction through n8n workflows, RAG candidate matching on Gemini embeddings, interview invites in one click.

projects.title: Coffee Leaf Disease
projects.desc: Diagnoses coffee leaves: EfficientNet-B0 classifier, Prototypical Networks that learn a rare disease from 2–5 photos, YOLO boxes around lesions.

projects.title: News Sentiment
projects.desc: Pulls news on any topic from NewsAPI or GNews, summarizes it with Gemini and scores sentiment with BERT, DistilBERT or RoBERTa.

projects.title: AI Speaking Coach
projects.desc: Speak out loud to an AI tutor. One of a series of voice-tutor apps for English, Japanese and Vietnamese ↔ English conversation.

projects.title: Semantic Customer Search
projects.desc: Find customers by meaning instead of keywords: Google embeddings in MongoDB Atlas Vector Search behind a Streamlit UI.

projects.title: IELTS Writing Grader
projects.desc: FastAPI service that checks spelling and grammar, grades IELTS essays by band with Google Generative AI, and runs a study chatbot.
